EventGroup.description: EventGroup defines the objects placed together when a position in cfgeventspawns.xml references this group.

child.description: Children are the objects in the composition. Their positions are offsets from the event spawn position.

name.description: Name is the identifier matched by the event spawn's `group` attribute.

EventGroupChild.description: EventGroupChild defines one object and its placement or loot behavior within an event group.

a.description: A is the object's yaw rotation in degrees.

deloot.description: Deloot sets the amount of dynamic-event loot requested for this object, overriding the default amount.

lootmax.description: LootMax is the maximum number of random items requested for this event child.

lootmin.description: LootMin is the minimum number of random items requested for this event child.

spawnsecondary.description: SpawnSecondary controls whether spawning this object starts its secondary infected event.

type.description: Type is the game class spawned as this object in the composition.

x.description: X is the horizontal X offset from the event spawn position.

y.description: Y is the vertical offset from the event spawn position.

z.description: Z is the horizontal Z offset from the event spawn position.

eventgroupdef.description: XMLName is XML root marker for `<eventgroupdef>`.

group.description: Groups is list of reusable static object groups.
